PRE-TREATMENT INSTRUCTIONS FOR TINTING

  • Avoid exfoliating products or retinol around the brow area for 48 hours before treatment.
  • Do not apply brow makeup or self-tanner before your appointment.

POST-TREATMENT INSTRUCTIONS FOR TINTING

  • Avoid getting brows wet for 24 hours after tinting.
  • Do not rub or scrub the brows.
  • Avoid oil-based skincare products on the brows, as they can fade the tint faster.

PRE-TREATMENT INSTRUCTIONS FOR WAXING

  • Avoid exfoliants, retinol, and active skincare on the brow area for 5-7 days before.
  • Do not apply makeup, lotion, or self-tanner before your appointment.
  • Let your brow hair grow to at least 1/4 inch for the best results.

POST-TREATMENT INSTRUCTIONS FOR WAXING

  • Expect mild redness or sensitivity for a few hours post-wax.
  • Avoid touching, picking, or applying makeup to the area for 24 hours.
  • Do not use exfoliants, retinoids, or harsh skincare on the brows for 48 hours.
  • Apply a soothing aloe-based gel if needed.
